title: Ship a PR in one call: krn pr ship does push, create, auto-merge, wait and cleanup
body:
Outcome: one command pushes the branch, creates the PR from a body file with the conventional title, enables auto-merge, waits through the merge, removes the worktree and branch, and prints one verdict line; lead turns on the delivery sequence fall from ~9-10 to about 3 per PR.
Why: .krn/runs/roadmap-refill-4/report.md: delivery-sequence turns (worktree add/remove, commit, push, pr create, pr merge, ci wait, pr view, fetch) were 1021 turns, $83.1 (19% of lead $) over 99 sessions and >=100 merged PRs; `krn ship` no longer exists (exit 64), so every step is a separate lead turn.
Proof: tests against a fake gh/git receiver for green, red Check, conflict and refused title (KRN-12); rerun p.py on 30 new PRs: delivery-sequence turns per merged PR at or below 4, about $0.5 less per PR.
Scope: src/ CLI command and tests, krn-lead SKILL and lanes.md ship section; builds on the ci wait merge-verdict task.
